method: Minimum conservative radial-forward CameraMotionPlan v1 authored by inspecting the exact A–F frames. Not Cinematographer output. Not Director output.

rationale.A: Night forest path toward the tree-trunk / root gateway in mist. VP on the walkable opening slightly left of center.
rationale.B: Root-tunnel mouth. VP on the dark opening slightly right of center so the left mushroom alcove can pass as foreground.
rationale.C: Centered circular root tunnel. VP on the black opening.
rationale.D: Root tunnel with a large glowing crystal cluster occupying the path. VP behind the crystal; bbox protects the crystal mass.
rationale.E: Dark reflective corridor toward a tall vertical portal. Narrow tall bbox around the portal.
rationale.F: Open void / debris field around a central light. Radial-forward toward that light is the only valid current Camotion model. This is not a corridor; yaw/strafe would be a Camotion extension and is out of scope.
